page.layout: One printed page, one text block in a single column; no marginal notes. Top: page number ornament (I.) above the title block. Then headings, then the opening paragraph with a signature line "A Athenis" at its foot.

p.i: In actu promotionis autumnali, 13. Octobris Anno 1658. habita.

CELSISSIME PRINCEPS, Domine clementissime. Magnifice Domine Pro-Rector: Patres Academici admodum reverendi, consultissimi, clarissimi, acutissimi; Collegæ honorandi: Verbi divini Præcones reverendi: Classium Præceptores præstantissimi: Archigrammateæ spectatissime: Consules & Scabini prudentissimi: Hospites, quotquot in hunc campum Parnassium spectatores confluxistis, humanissimi & gravissimi: Studiosi nobilissimi literis & virtutibus ornatissimi: Tuq; Palladia juventus, unica deliciæ nostræ; magna etiam nostra, & parentum spes!

page.notes: The page-number ornament reads "(I.)" as printed. The title block is set in roman capitals with an italic dateline. The "A" and "Athenis" line is the closing signature of the opening address, set beside each other at the foot of the paragraph. Ornamental rules above and below the heading are not text.
